thread:
Maya: quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need concrete owners/timelines for test+eval work tied to the KV-eviction pattern. goal: get reproducible regression coverage, incident-derived promptset, staging load profile, and a scoped chaos drill.
Ethan: i can own the regression harness + PR gating. plan: small fast subset for PRs + full nightly. ETA 2025-04-02.
Nora: i'll curate the promptset from the incident traces and tag samples by failure mode (truncated prefix, kv-miss cascade, mem-pressure). aiming for ~30 prompts with golden responses. ETA 2025-04-08.
Diego: i'll handle staging load jobs and the first chaos drill. propose weekly spike runs in staging (Fri 00:00 UTC) and a monthly controlled cross-region failover. need runbook & rollback commands. ETA infra-as-code 2025-04-10.
Maya: thanks. i'll create tickets and link them into the remediation tracker. also adding a weekly digest that clusters similar incidents (label: kv-eviction-pattern) and auto-creates triage entries when threshold crossed.
Ethan: gating preference: critical/high tests block; medium advisory. i'll add severity tags to tests and hook gating into the release pipeline. snippet of the GH action i'll use: ```yaml
name: kv-regress
on: schedule
schedule:
  - cron: '0 4 * * *'
jobs:
  run:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./tests/run_kv_regress.sh --mode nightly
```
Nora: for evals, i'll include both perf and quality checks (p95, token-loss, and BLEU/ROUGE-ish overlap). i'll store artifacts in the evals bucket and add a simple dashboard.
TicketBot: created INF-7001 "KV eviction regression harness" -> Ethan (due 2025-04-02).
TicketBot: created INF-7002 "KV eviction promptset & evals" -> Nora (due 2025-04-08).
TicketBot: created INF-7003 "Staging load profile & chaos drill" -> Diego (due 2025-04-10).
Maya: add a quick detector rule: eviction-rate > 5% AND p95 latency > 2x => auto-digest entry. Ethan, can you prototype the detector?
Ethan: yes, i'll open a follow-up PR and wire alerts to #eng-sre + the ticket comments.
Diego: chaos checklist items i'll include: pre-check health, canary fallback mapping, abort/rollback cmd, pager list, and observable thresholds. will share draft before infra commit.
Maya: i also want a recurring "incident pattern watch" ticket: triage when the digest shows >=3 similar incidents in 14 days. i'll add that to the tracker and assign ops-sre as secondary.
Nora: i'll include minimal repro scripts in the promptset repo to speed debugging.
Ethan: small ask: make regression job names consistent so we can aggregate history: releases/kv-eviction/{pr,nightly}.
Maya: agreed. i'll standardize names and update the releases gating doc: block if any critical test fails on main.
TicketBot: calendar event created: "KV remediation sync" 2025-03-29 15:00 UTC -> owners.
Maya: syncing 2025-03-29 to review initial PRs and promptset. flag blockers on the tickets. thanks team. :thumbsup:
Diego: thanks.
Nora: thanks, all.
Ethan: will get the first PR up by EOD tomorrow.
